Roof deck with 360 views of city skyline. All appliances included in the sale including in unit washer and dryer. 24 access to condo gym. Commercial space in building includes, Hombre y Lobo,Every Body Plus, and Be You Evolution.Please note- water is included in the HOA for individual unit.
